subject: RFI: Control provenance mapping + sample encrypted packet request
messages:
From: Elena Novak <elena@quantumrollup.com>
To: rohan_mehta@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@quantumrollup.com
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: RFI: SOC2/ISO/SIG — control provenance & sample packets

Hi Rohan,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. As part of our procurement and security intake we need a concise control provenance mapping and a small sample packet demonstrating how Redwood encrypts and stores request payloads for embeddings and generation. Specifically we are asking for: 

- SIG v2024 control crosswalk (mapping Redwood controls to SIG identifiers)
- SOC 2/ISO-identified evidence artifacts (logs, telemetry samples, policy snippets)
- A single compressed sample packet with a short encrypted payload (<= 2KB) and the metadata we can use to validate key provenance (timestamps, key IDs, KMS provider metadata). If possible, include a simple verification README describing how to check the packet.
- Attestation text stating whether keys are HSM-backed or KMS-managed, and the retention policy for KV cache/telemetry.

We need to ingest this into our portal by Aug 18 to keep the review window open. Can you confirm owners and an ETA? I attached our intake template for reference.

Regards,
Elena Novak
Head of Security Operations
QuantumRollup, Inc.
[attachment: quantumrollup_rfi_template.docx]

From: rohan_mehta@redwood.com
To: Elena Novak <elena@quantumrollup.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFI: SOC2/ISO/SIG — control provenance & sample packets

Hi Elena — thanks for sending the template and the scope. We'll own this end-to-end. High-level plan: 

1) Control crosswalk (SIG v2024) — deliver PDF + CSV mapping (owner: Monica) by EOD Aug 14
2) Evidence artifacts (logs, telemetry sample, policy exports) — gated delivery Aug 16 (owner: Karthik)
3) Encrypted sample packet + README — create small packet with KMS metadata and verification notes by Aug 17 (owner: Rohan)
4) Signed attestation about key provenance and HSM status — include short text and contact for validation

Two quick clarifications: do you require AES-GCM payloads specifically or is any AEAD acceptable? Also, do you want evidence demonstrating on-prem HSM vs cloud KMS? We'll prepare both notes but can prioritize based on your preference.

I'll start the internal runbook and attach our evidence intake matrix.

Thanks,
Rohan
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
redwood.com
[attachment: evidence_matrix.xlsx]

From: rohan_mehta@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: QuantumRollup RFI — evidence owner assignments

Team — copying the asks from QuantumRollup so we can align owners and dates. Elena wants the SIG crosswalk + small encrypted sample packet and an attestation. Please see proposed split below and reply with "ack" and ETA if you need adjustments.

Owners & deliverables:
- Monica: SIG v2024 control crosswalk PDF + CSV, mapping notes for any control gaps (due: 2026-08-14 EOD)
- Karthik: Telemetry/log samples (anonymized), policy exports (retention, incident response), and the signed traceability snippet from KMS (due: 2026-08-16)
- Rohan: Packaged sample packet (<2KB payload) with verification README and a short attestation text; create secure upload link to portal (due: 2026-08-17)

Logistics notes:
- Use the evidence_matrix.xlsx to populate artifact locations and owners (I attached).
- For the sample packet: generate a payload that demonstrates prefix/KV caching behavior + KMS envelope encryption metadata. Do not include customer PII — use synthetic payloads only.
- We will upload the final evidence bundle to the vendor portal (audit-portal@thirdparty-audits.com) — we need the signed proof files and a control_crosswalk.pdf.

Thanks — please ack so I can confirm to Elena.

-Rohan

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: rohan_mehta@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: QuantumRollup RFI — evidence owner assignments

Ack — will deliver telemetry samples and the KMS traceability snippet. A couple of technical points:

- We'll vendor-redact runtime IPs and request IDs in the telemetry; samples will show token counts, latency histogram, and a mock trace-id for replay.
- For KMS proof, I'm packaging the signing chain (proof bundle) that references the key fingerprint and the HSM attestation statement where applicable. See attached.

I expect to have a tarball ready for review by Aug 16 morning.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Security Engineering
[attachment: kms_key_proof.tar.gz]

From: Elena Novak <elena@quantumrollup.com>
To: rohan_mehta@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@quantumrollup.com
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 08:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFI: SOC2/ISO/SIG — control provenance & sample packets

Rohan — quick clarification from our side: QuantumRollup requires an HSM-backed key statement for all production root keys. If Redwood can provide the HSM attestation that covers the key(s) used to envelope customer payloads, that would satisfy our KMS proof requirement. If not, please explain the difference and provide compensating controls. Also can you include a short redaction guide for the telemetry samples (what fields were redacted and why)?

Finally, can the sample packet verification be performed offline (we need a self-contained README + verification script) rather than requiring debug access to your environment?

Best,
Elena

From: rohan_mehta@redwood.com
To: Elena Novak <elena@quantumrollup.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFI: SOC2/ISO/SIG — control provenance & sample packets

Elena — thanks for the clarifying questions. Deliverables attached and summary below. We uploaded the same bundle to your vendor portal and included a short verification README so your security team can validate offline.

Delivered artifacts (attached and in portal):
- quantum_evidence_packet.zip — compressed bundle with a single encrypted sample payload (payload.txt) + metadata.json showing key_id, envelope_algorithm, timestamp, and verification steps
- sig_mapping.csv & control_crosswalk.pdf — SIG v2024 mapping and explanatory notes for any compensating controls
- kms_proof.txt — short attestation: production root keys are HSM-backed (vendor: CloudHSM Inc.) with reference to HSM attestation statement serial #CH-2025-778. Where a cloud KMS is used, we included the chain and proof bundle.

Redaction guidance: we removed customer identifiers, replaced IPs with "10.0.0.0/8" placeholders, and removed raw request bodies — telemetry contains only non-PII operational markers (token counts, timing, anonymized trace ids). The README in the bundle lists exact redacted fields.

Verification notes: the README contains a small python verification script (verify_packet.py) that accepts the packet and a public fingerprint to verify the envelope signature — no access to our environment required.

If you confirm receipt, we'll close this intake and follow up on any remediation items you surface. Happy to set up a validation call next week if useful.

Regards,
Rohan Mehta
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
[attachments: quantum_evidence_packet.zip, sig_mapping.csv, control_crosswalk.pdf, kms_proof.txt]
